name: Ruins of Degar'Alesh
title: Ruins of Degar'Alesh
summary: A large set of ruins on Degar'Alesh. The great temple is the Freebooter drop point, a smaller temple to the south holds the Ithaenc Archipelago portal, and the Deru Tree stands to the north (acpedia). In the kit, a symmetrical cross-shaped temple about 150 m square stands at z 48. A 51 m five-storey central tower with an arched door is ringed by four 37 m halls, colonnaded corner halls and red-roofed outer ranges. A southern avenue lined with golden skull towers and 8 m wooden masks leads to the smaller castle-like temple, all in jungle.

site.notes: The gazetteer entry for this POI is only a map @tele and the nearest exact teleport (Olthoi Tunnel) is a dungeon mouth 135 m south; derived @teleloc on the open temple avenue 92 m south of the great temple, between the skull towers (ground z 48.0, nearest bush 9.1 m).

shots.standingOrder: Hang 120 m straight above the great temple of Degar'Alesh and turn slowly so its cross of red-roofed halls and the jungle around wheel like a mandala; stay 60 m above the central tower.
shots.notes: Top-down from 120 m over the great temple, turning 35 degrees. Its cross of red-roofed halls round the 51 m central tower reads like a mandala in the jungle, with the skull-tower avenue leading south and the morning shadows (0.38) cast north-west. The camera hangs 69 m above the tower.
